title: Monzo/Neobank
content: Apply Monzo aesthetic with digital banking feel. Coral/bright color palette. Spending category breakdowns. Transaction feed with merchant logos. Budget and savings pots. Instant payment notifications. Card management. Analytics and insights. Bill splitting. Salary sorting. Travel features.

variants.simple: Create digital banking interface with spending insights, budgets, and instant transactions.
variants.detailed: Apply Monzo aesthetic with digital banking feel. Coral/bright color palette. Spending category breakdowns. Transaction feed with merchant logos. Budget and savings pots. Instant payment notifications. Card management. Analytics and insights. Bill splitting. Salary sorting. Travel features.
variants.advanced: Apply Monzo aesthetic with neobank patterns. Colors: coral (#ff5c57) primary, hot coral gradient for card, white backgrounds. Card: virtual card display with details, freeze toggle, PIN reveal. Feed: transaction list with merchant logos (rounded), amount, category color dot, pending status. Categories: colored rings/bars showing spend by category (groceries, transport, etc). Balance: large prominent number, animated count up. Spending: weekly/monthly bar chart, comparison to last period. Pots: savings goals with progress rings, round-up savings, locked pots. Payments: send money with contacts, QR codes, scheduled payments. Split: bill splitting with contact selection, status tracking. Insights: spending alerts, unusual activity, subscription detection. Salary: early salary arrival, automatic sorting to pots. Travel: foreign spending stats, rate comparison, travel report. Notifications: instant push with transaction details, spend alerts. Card controls: gambling blocks, online payments toggle, location security. Summary: monthly summary with stats and insights. Export: PDF statements, CSV export. Search: transaction search, filter by amount/date/merchant. Skeleton loading: shimmer effect matching layout. Responsive: mobile-first design, desktop expansion.

author: Ersin KOÇ
